About Latunde Akin & HCTM

Have Compassion on Them Missions (HCTM)

HAVE COMPASSION ON THEM MISSIONS is a burden-driven ministry established to win unreached souls, awaken grassroots discipleship, and provide spiritual, logistical, and financial sustenance for suffering missionaries.

Core Pillars:
• Discipleship: Turning churchgoers into reproducing disciples of Jesus.
• Frontline Care: Providing food, shelter, and financial relief for missionaries in distant and unreached territories.
• Night Intercession: Unbroken marathon prayer watch dismantling evil foundations and speaking revival over the land.
